cbc_firecontrol.calculator.tasks.hint: The console column lists orders still waiting for a mount; each mount column shows the order it is working on and the depth behind it.
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.tasks.tooltip: An order no mount could take stays here; any card inserted later collects it.

Each mount works its own queue: an order it cannot take within ten checks (one per 10 ticks) is dropped from that queue alone, and taking an order fires it over the wireless fire channel once the gun is on aim.
Front order %s: %s - %s refusal chance(s) left, %s order(s) queued
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.target_design: Fire mission queued: handed to %s mount queue(s)
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.status.title: Link status
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.channels.sync: Copy the linked mounts' radio columns into this console's channels. Only what a mount states is copied; a channel configured here by hand is left alone.
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.channel.hint: Two filter items make one Create redstone-link frequency pair. Put the same pair in the same order in the linked mount's radio channel to receive this calculator's signal.
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.channel.inact: Inactive slot: channels transmit only while the slot holds a bound card
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.channel.idle_: Not driving this mount: the console signal (%s) now only gates the fire channel
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.channel.drivi: Driving: the link is slewing this mount, at a rate proportional to the angle still off
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.channel.on_ai: On aim: inside the deadband, so correction has stopped and the fire channel is open
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.channel.deadb: Stop tolerance: ±%s° of barrel angle, and it takes ±%s° of error to be off aim again. Both angles are fixed, so at long range the shot can still land past the hit tolerance the numbers above quote.

cbc_firecontrol.calculator.target.clear_: Clear the target; the rows go back to showing each mount's next shot.
cbc_firecontrol.calculator.target.aim_hi: Arm the wireless link for every mount this calculator records, so each one is driven to the aim its row solved for the stored target. A row whose shot would fly through terrain, or whose breech cannot fire, is left alone
